summary: Firmable is a Melbourne-headquartered AI B2B sales intelligence company that raised a $14M Series A in March 2026 for US expansion. Sam Leigh became Head of Finance in April 2026 and the team hired a Senior Financial Accountant (Alex Choo, July 2026) to run close across five jurisdictions. The finance team is AI-forward: the ad is explicit about AI, and a cadet is building AI-assisted accounting tools.

hooks.text: New Head of Finance plus five-jurisdiction close hiring ad: multi-entity and intercompany recs are the pain.
Series A and US expansion drive entity and FX complexity.
AI-native culture: position Vert as the traceable, ready-made alternative.

risks.text: Strong in-house AI appetite: cadet building AI accounting tools and Luyten hackathon project (agentic month-end close). May prefer to build, or see Vert as competing with DIY. Write to Sam, not Lucas.

first.subject: Five-entity close at Firmable
first.body:
Hi Sam,

Congrats on stepping up to Head of Finance in April. Your Senior Financial Accountant ad describes five jurisdictions, one finance function, with intercompany reconciliations in every close and Airwallex and Razorpay feeding the ledger. After the March Series A took Firmable into the US, that load only grows. I'm building Vert, which reconciles and cash codes with a traceable audit trail instead of guessing, turning hours of recs into minutes. How much of your close still goes on intercompany and payout matching?

Best,
Dawoud
